messages.author: d05269592cf87d3d
messages.subject: Correlation residuals
parts:
Hi, 

Is it possible in lavaan to get correlation residuals between latent variables? I can only find correlation residuals between observed variables. 

Greetings, 

Arjan

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Correlation residuals
parts:
On 07/30/2015 03:29 PM, Arjan van Dam wrote:
> Hi,
>
> Is it possible in lavaan to get correlation residuals between latent
> variables? I can only find correlation residuals between observed
> variables.

You can get them (in covariance metric) as follows:

lavInspect(fit, "est")$psi

If the latent variables are endogenous, the covariance elements are in
fact residual covariances. If the latent variables are exogenous, they
are just 'plain' covariances.

If you must have correlation matrix, use

cov2cor(lavInspect(fit, "est")$psi)

Yves.
